title: Projects get a more prominent place
summary:
Projects moved up front, community additions joined the showcase, and Unity’s image instructions got a tune-up.

Projects moved higher on the homepage, with a new “For Teens 🚀” tab drawing from featured projects across existing categories. The update also renamed “Creative & Interactive Applications” to “Creative Apps” and broadened the mature-content check.

The project listings gained CalcuBite AI, which estimates nutrition from food photos. The SDK showcase also added a community Node.js and TypeScript client covering images, text, and speech.

The Unity persona now points image generation to `flux` instead of Unity, with expanded image-style instructions.

highlights.title: Featured projects up front
highlights.text: Find featured projects in the new “For Teens 🚀” tab. Projects also sit higher on the homepage, so there’s less scrolling before you find something to try. [Explore projects](https://pollinations.ai).
